lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Gallery's full, floor is closed, and if you're press you're late by about four hours, which — and I say this kindly — is roughly when press usually arrives.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Third reading of a private member's bill. It'll pass on the nod. Forty members on the floor, none of them briefed against it, and a private member's bill at third reading with nobody briefed against it has never once failed in my time here, which is thirty-one years.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: You got into the lobby. Good for you. There's no division list in there — not misfiled, not lost. There was no division, because nobody asked for one, and a division only happens if somebody asks.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: So now there's a record. Not of the vote. Of you asking. That's the first entry in that book in nine years.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: You've read it. Nobody reads them. That's not cynicism, that's the workload — eleven pages times forty bills a week. Go on then. What does it do.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Carried, with the naming clause. Eleven pages, and one of them is now about who benefits, which nobody will notice for about three hundred years.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: I've been a clerk here for thirty-one years and that is the most anyone has ever got out of this House while I was standing in it. I'd like that written down somewhere, and there's nowhere to write it, so I'm telling you.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Withdrawn at third reading. Which feels like something. I'll tell you what happens now, because I've watched it four times: it comes back inside a year as a schedule to a finance act.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Same bill. Same words. No gallery, no third reading, and nobody in the country reads a schedule to a finance act. You've bought them eleven months and cost them an audience.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: You witnessed the register. Odd thing to want, and I'd have talked you out of it if you'd asked, which you didn't.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: A witness signature outlives the signatory, you see. It's the one mark in this building that can't be withdrawn, amended or explained. Most people find that unpleasant once it's done. You look like you knew.
